name: 330 Electronics, LLC
old_description: 330 Electronics specializes in flexible PCB assembly built for OEMs and engineering teams. From prototypes to ongoing production, we deliver responsive support, consistent quality, and predictable lead times—without the constraints of high-volume manufacturers.
about:
Based in Buckner, Kentucky, 330 Electronics, LLC operates as a U.S.-based electronics manufacturing services provider specializing in flexible PCB assembly for original equipment manufacturers and engineering teams. The company focuses on low-volume, high-mix production runs, offering a responsive alternative to high-volume manufacturers.

Its core services span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, mixed-technology builds, selective and hand soldering, and full turnkey material procurement. Beyond circuit boards, the company delivers box-build integration including sub-assembly, final assembly, cable and harness integration, packaging, and fulfillment. A dedicated division designs and manufactures UL-listed custom temperature control systems, providing rapid prototype PCB fabrication, testing, and system integration.

The customer base includes OEM manufacturers seeking dependable production support, engineering and product development teams transitioning from prototype to production, and operations and supply chain leaders aiming to reduce complexity. Served industries explicitly cited are automotive electronics and renewable energy.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing for shorter communication cycles and reduced supply chain uncertainty, an engineering-focused approach that simplifies development-to-production transitions, and scalable solutions tailored to changing requirements. Quality is integrated throughout the process with visual inspection, functional testing, and controlled manufacturing processes.
